Everybody has their own spark

Ignite yours with us

93 Positions in 9 Locations
Location
Department

Your Time
to Shine

At Nova, you have the power to move the needle at the forefront of technology. You’ll work in good company at a leading metrology innovator, where “disruptive” is the keyword. Your personal impact makes a world of difference, and when you grow- we all grow, together.

Why Work With Us?

Matter at Work

Matter at Work

In today’s world, we want our daily work to have meaning, to make a difference. At Nova, we each, in our own way, have room to make an impact on technology that pushes the industry limits, at the kind of place where people across the organization know each other's names

Work in Good Company

Work in Good Company

When cracking a challenge you’re never alone. We rely on each other for brainstorms and good advice. Bringing products to life globally stems from the innovation flowing through our meeting rooms and virtual spaces. This is why we’ve been repeatedly recognized as a best employer, winning multiple awards.

Work on What Matters

Work on What Matters

People here are always learning, researching, and coming up with one groundbreaking solution after another, every day. Because we work on the things that matter and together, we take technologies from mere ideas to the edge of reality

Work at a Leading Company

Work at a Leading Company

As a leading semiconductor metrology company with a rich differentiated portfolio, we work with every leading manufacturer worldwide. With an installed base of +7000 tools, We are uniquely positioned to understand customer needs. This is why we continue to outperform our industry growing year after year.

Impact Beyond Work

Impact Beyond Work

We are committed to foster an inclusive, open-minded, and accepting environment where every individual is seen as a whole, valued, heard and respected. This commitment extends beyond our walls, as we partner with our employees to drive impactful, tangible and tailored actions to bridge the gaps within the communities surrounding us.

All Open Positions

Perks and Benefits

What people say they love about their experience at work

Financial Wellbeing

Get equity-based compensation plans, and locally adjusted pension plans, health plans, and PTO policy

Work-Life Balance

Work in a hybrid environment with a flexible approach to office hours, plus a home-office budget

Health & Wellness

Access to outdoor and indoor fitness classes and activities, as well as ergonomic work facilities

The Individual as a Whole

Acknowledge and share professional and personal milestones like excellence, seniority, and birthdays

Care for your Family

Celebrate your family's special moments with the entire team, stand by each other through life's challenges and happy moments

Tasty Treats and Fun Swag

Stay fueled with locally adjusted meal benefits, team happy hours, delicious food in the office, unique gifts, and special occasions

Professional Development

Get support for life-long learning through personalized training, tuition reimbursement, internal talks, course access, and Nova’s buddy program
